mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_ai_usage_daily(id,tenant_id,usage_date,business_zone,snapshot_version,input_tokens,output_tokens,cached_input_tokens,estimated_tokens,turn_count,tool_calls,unknown_usage_turns,reported_at,created_at,updated_at,created_by,updated_by) VALUES(#{id},#{event.tenantId},#{event.usageDate},#{event.businessZone},#{event.version},#{event.inputTokens},#{event.outputTokens},#{event.cachedInputTokens},#{event.estimatedTokens},#{event.turnCount},#{event.toolCalls},#{event.unknownUsageTurns},#{event.reportedAt},CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,NULL,NULL) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,usage_date) WHERE NOT deleted DO UPDATE SET business_zone=EXCLUDED.business_zone,snapshot_version=EXCLUDED.snapshot_version, input_tokens=EXCLUDED.input_tokens,output_tokens=EXCLUDED.output_tokens,cached_input_tokens=EXCLUDED.cached_input_tokens, estimated_tokens=EXCLUDED.estimated_tokens,turn_count=EXCLUDED.turn_count,tool_calls=EXCLUDED.tool_calls,unknown_usage_turns=EXCLUDED.unknown_usage_turns, reported_at=EXCLUDED.reported_at,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL WHERE tenant_ai_usage_daily.snapshot_version < EXCLUDED.snapshot_version
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens),0) AS input_tokens,COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens),0) AS output_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(cached_input_tokens),0) AS cached_input_tokens,COALESCE(SUM(estimated_tokens),0) AS estimated_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(turn_count),0) AS turn_count,COALESCE(SUM(tool_calls),0) AS tool_calls,COALESCE(SUM(unknown_usage_turns),0) AS unknown_usage_turns FROM tenant_ai_usage_daily WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND usage_date >=#{from} AND usage_date <#{to} AND NOT deleted

SELECT usage_date,snapshot_version AS version,input_tokens,output_tokens,cached_input_tokens,turn_count,tool_calls,unknown_usage_turns,estimated_tokens,reported_at FROM tenant_ai_usage_daily WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND usage_date >=#{from} AND usage_date <#{to} AND NOT deleted ORDER BY usage_date
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_ai_usage_daily SET deleted=true,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND NOT deleted
